How a chip in your head meets your implants.

A personality construct in your head is chrome too: it counts **20 Load**.

Constructs can't use implants themselves (they have no body).

**Chrome Link**: they see your load and cyberpsychosis.
**Neural Buffer**: your pressure fades faster and the disease grows slower.
**Chrome Override**: they fire your Sandevistan or Blood Pump for you.

**Short Circuit** shuts off a target's active implants and puts them on cooldown.
**System Lock** locks them out for 30 s.
**Deep Scan** lists a target's implants.
Put an implant in a **Cyberware Painting Station** and paint its model texture: brush, bucket, eraser, picker, undo. **Save** writes it to the item; it shows on your body.
guide.constructchip.crafting.crafting_gu:
Recommended order:

- Get Soldering Iron
- Craft T1 intermediates
- Build WD, Kiroshi, FA
- Trade for T2-T3 Parts
- Upgrade Sandevistan
- T4: Gorilla, T5: Apogee

Most cyberware needs **intermediates** first.

Examples:
- OS Frame T1 > Sandevistans
- Arms Chassis T3 > Gorilla Arms
- Hemo Chamber T2 > Blood Pump
- Ocular Socket T2 > Kiroshi

Assembly uses the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid). Put the Soldering Iron and the parts in a crafting grid; you get the iron back.

Browse recipes — filtered by what you can craft.
guide.constructchip.crafting.internal_pa: Upgrade materials — obtainable only from the Ripperdoc villager.

**Internal Parts** T1-T5 are the core upgrade currency — obtained **exclusively** from the Ripperdoc villager.

Each tier unlocks a range of upgrades across all cyberware. Higher tiers require more villager reputation.

- **T1 — Basic**: Early-game upgrades.
- **T2 — Standard**: Mid-tier improvements.
- **T3 — Advanced**: Higher-end cyberware.
- **T4 — Military**: Top combat augments.
- **T5 — Top-of-the-Line**: Endgame. Requires max villager rep.
guide.constructchip.crafting.ripperdoc_v:
The **Ripperdoc** villager is tied to the Ripperdoc block.

Place the block near an **unemployed villager** to assign them. A single block can support **up to 4 Ripperdoc villagers** simultaneously.

They offer supplies unavailable anywhere else.

Trades by level:

- Lv1: Soldering Iron
- Lv1-2: Immuno doses
- Lv2-5: Parts T1-T5

Trade to unlock higher tiers.
guide.constructchip.crafting.soldering_i: Required tool for all cyberware assembly.

The **Soldering Iron** is the mandatory tool used in every cyberware assembly recipe at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).

It is not consumed during crafting — it acts as a reusable tool held in the crafting table tool slot.

Sold exclusively by the **Ripperdoc villager** (Level 1 trade):

Cost: **18 Emeralds + 12 Iron Ingots**

Since it is not consumed, you only need to buy it once. Keep it safe — losing it means another trip to the villager.
guide.constructchip.cyberpsychosis.manag:
1. **Never exceed capacity.** Remove or upgrade first.

2. **Don't stack activations.** Sandevistan + Gorilla Arms + Face Scan = massive Pressure.

3. **Keep Immuno stocked at 16.**

One dose provides:

- Pressure: -80 to -200
- Degradation: -60 to -180

Scales with phase — can roll back one phase.

Dose early, not at Phase 3.

These are not suggestions. Ignore the rules and Night City will collect its debt.

Your mind fractures. Your body turns against you. There is no mercy at Phase 5 — only the cold static of a flatlined chrome ghost.
guide.constructchip.cyberpsychosis.overv: The price of too much chrome.

Every implant is trauma on your nervous system. The brain tolerates chrome up to a limit. Past that, it breaks down.

Cyberpsychosis: a progressive neurological disease. Five phases. Unchecked, it kills you.

The disease runs on two values:

**Pressure** (0-1000): Short-term stress from active cyberware. Falls when you rest.

**Degradation** (0-1000): Long-term disease progress. Rises when Pressure is high. Falls slowly when Pressure is low.
guide.constructchip.cyberpsychosis.phase: Your system starts fighting the chrome.

Enter 340. Exit 260.

Body fights chrome.

- Watcher eyes nearby
- Hallucinations rise
- Fixed debuff cycle
- Misfire = implant

Immuno can drop to I.

Enters at Degradation 600. Exits at 500.

- Frequent hallucinations
- Stronger face glitches
- Motor instability starts
- IFF corruption begins: allies may look hostile

Immuno still works here but with reduced effect.

Stop all active cyberware now:
- Sandevistan
- Gorilla Arms
- Face scan

Do not reach this phase without a dose in hand.

Enters at 840. Exits at 730.

All symptoms persistent.

- Severe motor instability
- Heavy debuffs
- IFF corruption constant
- Relentless hallucinations

Terminal is next.
The point of no return — almost.

Enters at Degradation 980. Exits at 930.

A Terminal Window countdown begins. Stabilize before it expires, or you die.

Berserk episodes are longer and hit with full weapon damage.

Use every Immuno dose now. Stop all active cyberware - every activation adds Pressure.

If overloaded, remove an implant at the Ripperdoc.

If you die in Phase V, you return in Phase IV crisis.
The first sign of neurological stress.

Enters at Degradation 140. Exits at 90.

First sign. Still functional.

- Brief eye glitch bursts
- Error popup messages

One Immuno dose is enough to fully reverse this phase.
guide.constructchip.cyberpsychosis.press:
Pressure/s from active sources:

- Overload: scales with excess
- Sandevistan: +160/s
- Gorilla Arms: +140/s
- Face scan: +120/s
- Blood Pump: +100/s
- Immuno: -80/s

Decays when idle.

Degradation change by Pressure:

- P >= 720: +4/s
- P >= 560: +3/s
- P >= 420: +2/s
- P >= 300: +1/s
- P 60-300: 0/s

Stay below 300 to stop disease.

When Pressure is low, Degradation falls:

- P < 120: -1/s
- P < 60: -2/s
- Immuno bonus: -1 to -2/s
- Crisis + high P: +1/s

Deactivate cyberware between fights.
guide.constructchip.cyberpsychosis.termi: What happens when control is lost.

The chrome takes over: forced third-person, input lock, auto-aim, and auto-chase.

Berserk only runs while a valid target exists, and attacks fire on full-charge windows.

During berserk, you become temporarily invulnerable and can deflect incoming projectiles.

When the Terminal Window expires, you die. Returning in Phase IV is not safety - stabilize fast.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.axolotl.p0:
Neural processor in **Frontal Cortex** monitoring engagement patterns.

**Passive:** On every kill, all cyberware cooldowns are instantly reduced.

Load: 62 · Frontal Cortex
guide.constructchip.cyberware.axolotl.p1:
**CDR per kill:** 5%% (7.5%% upgraded)

Affects all cooldowns: OS, Arms, Face, Circulatory, Extra.

All kill types count.

Chain kills to keep Sandevistan active.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.bionic_joi: Movement polish — speed, falls, knockback. Load 8 · Tier 1
Raises movement speed, trims fall damage taken, and softens knockback. Later nodes reward clean landings with bonus Gorilla Fury.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.blood_pump:
Subdermal cardiac augmentation. Controlled adrenaline surge on command.

Activate with J: **instant HP** + regen window. Cooldown: 30s.

Load: 24 · Circulatory

4 tiers via **Internal Parts T2**:

- T2: +9 HP, 3.5/6s regen
- T3: +13 HP, 6.5 regen
- T4: +17.5 HP, 10.5 regen
- T5: +22 HP, 14 regen

Max tier: 36 HP total.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.dense_marr: Melee power — Gorilla Fury synergy. Load 16 · Tier 3

Pushes melee damage and Gorilla Fury generation while amplifying Gorilla Slam. Spikes **pressure** when you repeatedly spend Fury through saturation-fuelled swings — track the meter on implants that care.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.epimorphic: Endgame survival — health, heals, Load, pressure relief. Load 40 · Tier 5
Raises max health and incoming healing, then spends upgrades on cyberware **Load** tolerance and steady reductions to skeleton **pressure**.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.face_optic:
Face implants replace your eyes with augmented optics. All provide **zoom**; higher tiers add **scan modes**.

Activate scan with V. Duration: 60s. Cooldown: 30s.

Load / Zoom / Scan

- Kiroshi T2: 8, 2-6x, HP
- Clairvoyant T3: 14, 2-8x
- Doomsayer T3: 14, 2-8x
- Stalker T3: 14, 2-8x
- Oracle T5: 26, 2-12x, All

Entry-level optics. Passive **enemy HP HUD** above targets. Three zoom levels. No active scan.

Best starter face implant — low load, always useful.

Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).

Active scan mode: **Enemy Scanner** (19.5m range) highlights hostile entities and shows health data. Night Vision while scan is active. 4 zoom levels (2-8x).

Upgraded from Basic Kiroshi at crafting table.

Active **Hazard Scanner** (29m range) identifies environmental dangers — TNT, pistons, sculk sensors, trip wires.

4 zoom levels. Ideal for dungeon and trap detection.

Upgraded from Basic Kiroshi.

Scan: **Trail Tracker** (53m) illuminates enemy footprints. Night Vision included.

Best for tracking fleeing targets.

Upgraded from Basic Kiroshi.

Premium military optics. Combines **all three scan modes** plus Night Vision and widest zoom (2-12x).

The definitive face implant.

Upgraded from all previous face optics.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.fortified_:
Titanium-reinforced ankles for a **charged jump boost**.

**How to use:** Crouch to charge. Release Shift to hold charge briefly, then it fades. Jump to spend it.

Longer charge = higher jump.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.gorilla_ar:
Hydraulic arms that deploy when activated. **Arms slot**. Organic regions mirror your **player skin**; paint at the **Painting Station**.

Load: 35  ·  Slot: Arms

**While deployed** (B):

- Melee damage **+6**
- Each hit applies **Bleed**
- Damage tiers: 12%%-46%%
- Bleed tiers: 10%%-20%%

Hands mining works at **iron pickaxe** level and speed.

RMB checks **Grab** first. If none is valid, hold RMB in air at **half Fury** for **Slam**. More **Gorilla Fury** means more slam damage and size. Damage upgrades scale slam too. Finishers need low-HP targets. Creepers ignore this. Also grabs TNT, carts and boats.

One elemental effect (5x T4 each):

- **Thermal** — Ignites 10s
- **Electric** — Electroshock 5s
- **Toxic** — Poisons 10s
- **Frozen** — Cryolock 5s

Triggers first hit every 15s.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.hollow_bon: Trades raw durability for speed, jump height, and safer landings. Pairing exclusions are listed on **Skeleton Slots** — read that page before mixing other skeleton augments.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.hub.p0.tex:
Catalog by **Ripperdoc** body slot. **Skeleton** sits right of **Legs** and splits into Mobility, Combat, and Defense frame hubs.

Open each implant for stats and crafting recipe.

Controls for keybinds; cyberware inventory for upgrades.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.kinetic_fr: Chance-based mitigation that favours sprinting and high-speed motion, with optional Momentum Recovery bursts. Pauses entirely while **Scarab** Brace is active (see **Skeleton Slots**).
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.os_sandevi:
The **OS slot** houses the **Sandevistan**: the world slows to a fraction while you move at full pace.

Five variants from different manufacturers.

Load / Slow / Active / Cooldown

- Warp: 20/20%%/9s/70s
- Zetatech: 34/30%%/6s/45s
- Dynalar: 50/50%%/8s/55s
- Falcon: 68/70%%/9s/40s
- Apogee: 90/85%%/6s/30s

Entry-level Sandevistan by **QianT**. Applies **20%% slowdown** for 9 seconds.

Special: grants **elemental resistances** while active (fire, frost, electric, poison).

Load: 20  ·  Cooldown: 70s

Mid-tier OS by **Zetatech**. Applies **30%% slowdown** for 6s.

Special: damage bonus up to 12%%. Airborne enemies take +60%%.

Load: 34 · CD: 45s

Balanced mid-range OS by **Dynalar**. 50%% slowdown for 8 seconds. Reliable and versatile.

Special: damage bonus up to 10%%, extended duration at max tier.

Load: 50  ·  Cooldown: 55s

Military-grade OS by **Militech**. Applies **70%% slowdown** for 9 seconds.

Special: upgrades grant +5%% duration and +10-12%% max HP on neutralize.

Load: 68  ·  Cooldown: 40s

Militech's apex OS. Applies **85%% slowdown**.

Damage bonus scales to 18%%. Neutralizing while active extends duration +10%% base, +20%% upgraded.

Load: 90 · CD: 30s

Upgrade chain at the crafting table:

Warp Dancer > Zetatech > Dynalar > Falcon > Apogee

Each step: previous variant + OS Core + intermediate parts.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.para_bellu: Broad damage reduction — all common families. Load 25 · Tier 3
Layers physical, projectile, explosion, and elemental reduction in one chassis. Track how much budget remains after other skeleton pieces — caps are global.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
Heavy iconic armor — slow but tanky. Load 45 · Tier 5
Massive resistances with a movement tax and **Redline** bonuses when badly hurt. Adds **pressure** while combat-tagged — read other implants if you need to bleed that meter off.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.reinforced:
Hydraulic tendons that enable a **double jump**.

**How to use:** Jump, then press Jump again mid-air. No charge needed — always available.

Higher load than Fortified Ankles. Upgrades available.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.scar_coale: Low-HP toughness and bleed control. Load 20 · Tier 2
Surge physical mitigation while wounded, with optional melee aggression and bleed handling. Adds **pressure** when you ride the low-health band — pair with implants that care about that meter.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.scarab.des: Crouch brace shell — short-range counterplay. Load 14 · Tier 2
Hold crouch to brace, trading mobility for physical and projectile mitigation plus knockback immunity while planted. Brace disables **Kinetic Frame** mitigation — plan your loadout accordingly.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.skeleton_c: Skeleton passives for **combat**: melee scaling, resist profiles while fighting, slam synergy, and the Scarab crouch brace.

This branch is about **standing your ground and hitting harder** — damage scaling, layered mitigations in a fight, room-clear spikes, and the Scarab's planted guard. Pressure rules and Slam interactions are spelled out on each implant page.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.skeleton_d: Skeleton passives for **defense**: broad mitigation toward caps, heal synergies, chrome tolerance, and emergency survival spikes.

These implants stack **survival layers** — resistances toward global caps, recovery bonuses, pressure relief, and panic buttons when you are low. How each piece spends the shared reduction budget is on its own entry.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.skeleton_m: Skeleton passives for **movement**: sprint speed, jump height, safe landings, spring recovery, and mitigation while you reposition.
**Mobility** passives: travel speed, jump height, landing control, springs. Hollow conflicts with Titanium/Dense marrow; Kinetic pauses in Scarab brace. Load and pressure on each implant page.
The **Arms slot** accepts a single combat limb augmentation. These implants reinforce your arms with mechanical systems designed to enhance close-quarters combat.

Upgrades and elemental variants are available for further specialisation.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.slot_circu:
The **Circulatory slot** accepts a single cardiac augmentation. These implants interface with your cardiovascular system to provide active physiological stabilisation during combat.

Upgrade tiers increase the potency of the recovery effect.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.slot_corte: The **Frontal Cortex slot** accepts a single neural processing implant. These augmentations enhance cognitive efficiency, passively improving the performance of your other active cyberware.
The **Face slot** accepts a single ocular augmentation. These implants replace your eyes and add zoom and scan tools.
The **Legs slot** accepts a single mobility augmentation. These implants enhance your lower-body mechanics for improved movement in and out of combat.

Two mutually exclusive variants are available — only one can be installed at a time.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.slot_os.p0:
The **OS slot** accepts a single operating system — the most powerful augmentation category.

Several variants exist with distinct trade-offs in performance and capabilities.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.slot_skele: Two passive frame slots — mobility, combat, and survival augments.

Two skeleton passives upgrade in the UI — no keybind. Reductions multiply toward **70%%** physical and **55%%** other caps; each implant cites its slice.

Hollow blocks Titanium, Dense, and Rara. Kinetic pauses in Scarab Brace. Pressure is per implant.
guide.constructchip.cyberware.spring_joi: Impact springs — rebound mobility. Load 16 · Tier 3
Softens chunky hits and falls while unlocking rebound jumps and bonus air control through its upgrade tree.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.titanium_b: Starter combat frame — resist and Slam. Load 6 · Tier 1
Adds physical and elemental resistance plus knockback relief in exchange for taking more fall damage. Upgrades widen the resist profile and keep the Gorilla Slam damage bonus online.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.cyberware.universal_: Resistance spikes after healing events. Load 25 · Tier 4
Builds resist stacks whenever heals tick, then temporarily **lowers active pressure** while the buff persists — ideal if other skeleton pieces spike that meter.
Crafted at the **crafting table** (with the Soldering Iron in the grid).
guide.constructchip.getting_started.capa: Know your limits — exceed them and you break.

Every implant has a **Load** shown in the Ripperdoc capacity bar.

Green = safe. Red = OVERLOAD.

**OVERLOAD** accelerates Cyberpsychosis until you drop below your max.

Base capacity is **randomly rolled** on first world entry: **160-320**, equal chance per value. Fixed for that world.

Multiplied via upgrades from the Ripperdoc:

x1.08 > x1.16 > x1.25 > x1.35 > x1.50
guide.constructchip.getting_started.heal: Food no longer heals. Your body, your problem.

Once you install cyberware, food **stops regenerating your hearts**. Eating still fills hunger — but it will not restore a single HP.

You must rely on cyberware or external means to heal.

Your healing options:

- **Cyberware** — some implants regenerate HP passively or on demand.
- **Consumables** — certain items can still restore health.

Remove all cyberware and your body returns to normal — food heals again.
guide.constructchip.getting_started.immu:
Pharmaceutical-grade injectors that suppress your body's rejection response to foreign cybernetics.

Stack to **16**. Can be consumed even at full health (always-eat).

Grants **Immunosuppression** for **30 min**:

- Capacity +**30%%** base
- Extra dose: +**10%%** each
- Pressure accrual -80/s
- Can roll back early phases

Immunosuppressants fill the **Suppressors slot** (max 16).

Two ways to consume them:
- **Direct**: hold in hand and use
- **Slot**: place in Suppressors slot and right-click them

**Source:** Ripperdoc villager trades only.
guide.constructchip.getting_started.inst:
Ready to augment? Head to the **Cyberware** section of this guide to browse all available implants by body slot.

Each entry explains what the cyberware does, its load cost, and how to craft it. Start with what fits your play style.

Many cyberware can be **upgraded** at the crafting table — reducing cooldowns, boosting stats, and unlocking new abilities.

Upgrades are bought at the **Ripperdoc** surgery screen with Internal Parts. Check each implant's entry for its upgrade chain.
guide.constructchip.getting_started.pain:
The **Cyberware Painting Station** recolors supported implants. **Right-click** the block and insert paintable cyberware in the left slot.

Designs save on the **item** and apply when equipped.

Paintable today: **Gorilla Arms**, **Blood Pump**, **Fortified Ankles**, **Reinforced Tendons**, all **Sandevistan** variants, and **Immunosuppressors**.

**Gorilla Arms** blend chrome with your **player skin** on organic regions.

1. Insert cyberware in the station slot.
2. Paint in the editor.
3. Press **Save** to write the design to the item.
4. Install and equip as normal.

**Revert** reloads the last saved design from the item.

**Face optics** — Kiroshi, Clairvoyant, Doomsayer, Stalker, Oracle — paint a **facial overlay on your player skin**, not the 3D implant mesh.

**Import/Export** shares JSON designs between players. Import loads the canvas only; **Save** still writes to the item.
guide.constructchip.getting_started.ripp:
The **Ripperdoc** is your augmentation station. Use it to **install and uninstall** cyberware at any time.

A single Ripperdoc block supports up to **4 villagers** simultaneously as a job-site — maximizing trade access from a single block.

**Sneak + right-click** the Soul Killer station (our Ripperdoc) to open surgery. Drag cyberware into the matching body slot to install — drag it out to uninstall.

Close the interface to confirm. The screen glitches when the surgery takes.

- **OS** — Sandevistans
- **Frontal Cortex** x3
- **Face** — Ocular
- **Arms** — Combat
- **Hands/Skeleton** x2
- **Circulatory** x3
- **Nervous** x2, **Skin** x3
- **Legs** — Mobility
- **Suppressors** x16
guide.constructchip.getting_started.welc:
**Night City doesn't forgive.**

Chrome is your edge. Implants sharpen reflexes, harden your body.

Push too far — **Cyberpsychosis**.

From first surgery to Terminal breakdown.

**Getting Started** — Ripperdoc, capacity, surgery, Painting Station

**Cyberware** — All implants

**Cyberpsychosis** — Disease system

**Crafting** — Build and upgrade cyberware

Read in order.

implant.constructchip.axolotl.desc: Frontal cortex processor: every kill cuts all your cyberware cooldowns by 5% (7.5% upgraded).
implant.constructchip.basic_kiroshi.desc: Optics: see the health of whatever you aim at, and zoom (hold C).
implant.constructchip.bionic_joints.desc: Skeleton: faster movement, softer falls, less knockback.
implant.constructchip.blood_pump.desc: Press J: instant healing plus regeneration. Upgrades heal more. 30 s cooldown.
implant.constructchip.clairvoyant.desc: Optics + scan (V): hostiles within 19.5 m glow, night vision. 60 s, 30 s cooldown.
implant.constructchip.dense_marrow.desc: Skeleton: +2 melee damage, faster Gorilla Fury and stronger Slams.
implant.constructchip.doomsayer.desc: Optics + scan (V): marks TNT, pistons, sculk sensors, tripwires and other hazards within 29 m.
implant.constructchip.dynalar.desc: Sandevistan: 50% slowdown for 8 s, +10% damage. Fully upgraded it runs longer. 55 s cooldown.
implant.constructchip.epimorphic_skeleto: Skeleton: +4 hearts, 20% stronger healing, +10% cyberware capacity, steady pressure relief.
implant.constructchip.falcon.desc: Militech Sandevistan: 70% slowdown for 9 s. Every kill while it runs heals 10% of your health. 40 s cooldown.
implant.constructchip.fortified_ankles.d: Crouch to charge, then jump: the longer the charge, the higher you go. Softer landings.
implant.constructchip.gorilla_arms.desc: Deploy (B): +6 melee damage, hits bleed and build Fury, bare hands mine like iron. Right-click empty-handed at 50+ Fury to Slam. Use with a blaze rod, lightning rod, fermented spider eye or blue ice in your other hand to add an element.
implant.constructchip.hollow_bones.desc: Skeleton: ultralight. Faster, higher jumps, safe landings, 2 fewer hearts. Can't share the skeleton with Titanium Bones, Dense Marrow or Rara Avis.
implant.constructchip.kinetic_frame.desc: Skeleton: while sprinting, a chance to shrug off a hit completely (not while Scarab-braced).
implant.constructchip.para_bellum.desc: Skeleton: 12% less damage of every kind.
implant.constructchip.rara_avis.desc: Skeleton: heavy iconic armor, 25% less damage but 10% slower; below 30% health you hit 20% harder. Fighting adds pressure.
implant.constructchip.reinforced_tendons: Press jump again in mid-air to double jump.
implant.constructchip.scar_coalescer.des: Skeleton: below 40% health you take less physical damage and hit harder. Stops bleeding.
implant.constructchip.scarab.desc: Skeleton: crouch to brace. 35% less physical and projectile damage while braced.
implant.constructchip.spring_joints.desc: Skeleton: much softer falls; hard landings give a rebound jump boost.
implant.constructchip.stalker.desc: Optics + scan (V): hostiles within 53 m glow and leave red trails, night vision.
implant.constructchip.the_oracle.desc: Military optics: all three scan modes, night vision, widest zoom.
implant.constructchip.titanium_bones.des: Skeleton: physical and elemental resistance, knockback relief, but falls hurt more.
Skeleton: whenever you're healed, a short resistance boost that also bleeds off pressure.
implant.constructchip.warp_dancer.desc: Sandevistan: the world slows 20% for 9 s. Fire, frost, shock and poison can't touch you while it runs. 70 s cooldown.

skill.constructchip.adrenal_surge.desc: Quickhack: Regeneration I and Speed I on the host for 6 s.
skill.constructchip.camera_blind.desc: Quickhack: cut a View Finder's feed for 20 s. Its TVs show static.
skill.constructchip.camera_view.desc: Quickhack: see through a Vista View Finder.
skill.constructchip.chrome_link.desc: Your HUD shows your host's cyberware load and cyberpsychosis.
skill.constructchip.chrome_override.desc: Quickhack: fire your host's Sandevistan for them, or their Blood Pump if the Sandevistan isn't ready.
skill.constructchip.deep_scan.desc: The Scanner also shows status effects, equipment and installed cyberware, and reaches 8 blocks further.
skill.constructchip.efficient_code.desc: +0.25 RAM per second, and quickhacks cost 10% less.
skill.constructchip.lightning_storm.desc: Quickhack: red lightning strikes every hostile creature within 12 blocks of your host for 5 damage.
skill.constructchip.neural_buffer.desc: You steady your host's mind: their cyberware pressure fades faster and cyberpsychosis grows 25% slower.
skill.constructchip.neural_overdrive.des: While Overclocked, quickhacks have no cooldowns. The lockout afterwards lasts 30 s longer.
skill.constructchip.overclock.desc: 30 s of healing, more damage and slightly less damage taken for the host, and half-price quickhacks. Afterwards every chip ability locks for 60 s.
skill.constructchip.pain_editor.desc: While the chip is installed, the host takes 10% less damage.
skill.constructchip.patch_job.desc: Quickhack: heals your host for 10, gives 4 extra hearts for 30 s, and cures poison, wither and fire.
skill.constructchip.ping.desc: Quickhack: hostile creatures within 24 blocks glow through walls for you and your host for 10 s, and you hear how many are on each side.
skill.constructchip.red_lightning.desc: Quickhack: a red bolt jumps from your host to a creature and fries it for 6 damage.
skill.constructchip.remote_switch.desc: Quickhack: flip a lever, door, trapdoor, fence gate or button in sight, as if the host used it.
skill.constructchip.scanner.desc: Look at a block or creature to read it: name, required tool, health, armor, and how hard the host would hit it. Free and always unlocked.
skill.constructchip.short_circuit.desc: Quickhack: disable a target's cyberware for 10 s.
skill.constructchip.signal_inject.desc: Quickhack: power a block in sight with redstone for 1 s, like pressing a button on it.
Overclock lasts 10 s longer and the lockout afterwards is 20 s shorter.
skill.constructchip.system_lock.desc: Quickhack: cut a target's active cyberware effects. It can't be turned back on for 30 s.
skill.constructchip.threat_alert.desc: When a creature starts targeting the host, the host hears a warning and sees which way it is.
skill.constructchip.tv_power.desc: Quickhack: turn a Vista TV on or off.
skill.constructchip.vitals_link.desc: The host HUD also shows the host's status effects and warns about gear that is about to break.
skill.constructchip.weak_point.desc: Quickhack: mark a creature. It takes 15% more damage from the host for 10 s.
tooltip.constructchip.immuno: Right-click: 30 min of immunosuppression. +30% cyberware capacity (+10% per extra dose), drains pressure, can roll back cyberpsychosis.
